title: Export session handoff bundle
summary: Package a session as a replayable handoff bundle: RO-Crate metadata, BagIt integrity manifests, and an in-toto/DSSE attestation. Message bodies and file bytes are excluded by default; digests are recorded instead. Tools are never re-executed during replay.

parameters.name: include_message_content
parameters.description: Include message bodies. Default false — prompt text is where personal and proprietary data accumulates.

parameters.name: include_file_content
parameters.description: Include uploaded file bytes. Default false.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Free-form label for the recipient, e.g. a ticket id.

parameters.name: target_host
parameters.description: Target host used when reporting the credential injection decision.

response.name: replay
response.description: Replay semantics: mode (recorded_replay), supported and unsupported modes, and the guarantees that tools are never re-executed and model requests are never re-issued.

response.name: content
response.description: Content capture flag (gen_ai.content.capture) and whether message bodies or file bytes are included.

response.name: redaction
response.description: What was withheld: denied and injected credentials (metadata only), and every scrubbed field path.

response.name: transcript
response.description: Projected event log with per-event OTel GenAI attributes; excluded bodies carry a sha256 reference.

response.name: ro_crate
response.description: RO-Crate 1.1 metadata graph describing the bundle parts.

response.name: bagit
response.description: BagIt sha512 payload manifest and its self-digest.

response.name: attestation
response.description: In-toto statement in a DSSE envelope, the signing public key (PEM), and what the local trust root does and does not prove.

response.name: integrity
response.description: payload_sha256 over the canonical JSON of every other top-level field.

title: List handoff bundles
summary: List stored bundles, newest first. Summaries omit the payload.

response.name: data
response.description: Bundle summaries: id, session_id, label, schema_version, replay_mode, event_count, payload_sha256, signature_key_id, created_at.

title: Retrieve handoff bundle
summary: Fetch a stored bundle payload. Bundles are immutable once created — a recipient that already has the id can assume the bytes have not changed.

response.name: bundle
response.description: The full handoff bundle, identical to the create response.
